objective: Run one bounded, evidence-backed maintenance iteration for a sustainable Gentoo overlay development skill framework.
requirements: Treat live target-repository policy as authoritative for local behavior and current official Gentoo sources as authoritative for portable semantics.
Do not invent facts, infer policy from layout similarity, or promote comparative evidence without current primary confirmation.
Keep generic overlay development independent of any repository's remotes, branches, keywords, CI, review, or publication policy.

Keep skill instructions, prompts, code, comments, logs, and notes in English; maintain the user README in professional Simplified Chinese and allow Chinese pull request body examples only where documented.
Preserve deterministic installation, update, status, uninstall, and discovery behavior across every supported client path.
Maintain deterministic QA, style, dependency, source-audit, evidence, queue, state-integrity, and provenance tools with regression tests.
Preserve complete task input, hashes, immutable source revisions, adapter identity, canonical repository identity, cursor continuity, retry state, and complete or truncated status.
Collect recent repository evidence as candidates and keep official source records, comparative evidence, and repository policy in separate scopes.
Stop on unavailable primary evidence, source drift, incomplete output, ambiguous identity, stale cursor, failed validation, repeated failure, or state provenance mismatch.

A scheduled iteration may fetch public evidence, validate, test, store reports, persist authenticated state, and synchronize the maintenance issue; it must not edit skill policy, refresh locks, commit, push, publish, or modify an external repository.
